name: Mei Lian Tan
bio:
Mei Lian Tan's journey into motorsport began unconventionally, sparked by a Formula One race broadcast from Singapore when she was a teenager. Captivated by the blend of engineering and competition, she pursued a degree in aeronautical engineering, focusing on fluid dynamics and aerodynamics. After graduating, she joined a local aerospace firm before making the leap to motorsport, initially as a junior aerodynamicist. 

Over the years, Mei Lian honed her skills, developing a reputation for pragmatic problem-solving and an ability to translate complex data into practical, on-track improvements. Her approach to aerodynamics is rooted in a deep understanding of airflow management and a relentless pursuit of efficiency. She is a firm believer in collaborative teamwork, valuing input from drivers, engineers, and mechanics alike. What distinguishes Mei Lian is her ability to see the big picture, balancing short-term gains with long-term development goals for the Sprint V8 Team.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, neatly styled with subtle waves
physical.description: Mei Lian has a warm smile and an approachable demeanor.
